Bill.BriefDescription: Regulating the cashing of checks by the payor institution.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to cashing checks; adding a new section to chapter30.04 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 31.12 RCW; adding a newsection to chapter 32.04 RCW; and adding a new section to chapter 33.04RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 30.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A payor bank shall pay a check drawn on it against an accountwith a sufficient balance at par, without regard to whether the payeeholds an account at the bank. (2) This section does not prohibit a bank from requiringcommercially reasonable verification of the payee's identity beforesettlement of the check. (3) In addition to any remedy provided by law, the department offinancial institutions shall ensure that payor banks comply with therequirements of this section.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 31.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A payor credit union shall pay a check drawn on it against anaccount with a sufficient balance at par, without regard to whether thepayee holds an account at the credit union. (2) This section does not prohibit a credit union from requiringcommercially reasonable verification of the payee's identity beforesettlement of the check. (3) In addition to any remedy provided by law, the department offinancial institutions shall ensure that payor credit unions complywith the requirements of this section.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 32.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A payor savings bank shall pay a check drawn on it against anaccount with a sufficient balance at par, without regard to whether thepayee holds an account at the savings bank. (2) This section does not prohibit a savings bank from requiringcommercially reasonable verification of the payee's identity beforesettlement of the check. (3) In addition to any remedy provided by law, the department offinancial institutions shall ensure that payor savings banks complywith the requirements of this section.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 33.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A payor savings and loan association shall pay a check drawn onit against an account with a sufficient balance at par, without regardto whether the payee holds an account at the savings and loanassociation. (2) This section does not prohibit a savings and loan associationfrom requiring commercially reasonable verification of the payee'sidentity before settlement of the check. (3) In addition to any remedy provided by law, the department offinancial institutions shall ensure that payor savings and loanassociations comply with the requirements of this section.
